_comment: Properties that exist and operate but publish no tenant directory, each confirmed against the operator's own live site on the date recorded. A zero-tenant mall is normally a defect in this pipeline, so every one of them has to be either fixed or accounted for here; anything empty and absent from this file is reported as an unexplained defect by `mallscape scrape`. Re-verify a `checked` date that has gone stale rather than trusting it: SM City La Union was in this position on 2026-07-26 and served 199 tenants on 2026-08-30.

megaworld:the-shoppes-at-mckinley-west.name: The Shoppes at McKinley West
megaworld:the-shoppes-at-mckinley-west.evidence: Listed in Megaworld's mall feed as uid bltd1ea5541ca1324e8. All 2,101 entries of the chain-wide tenant feed were scanned and not one references that uid.
